query:
SELECT
            EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM places p
                WHERE p.id = $1 AND (p.id = $4 OR can_see_scoped(p.owner_id, p.family_id, $3))
            ) AS "is_visible!",
            ($2::uuid IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM place_addrs a WHERE a.id = $2 AND a.place_id = $1)) AS "is_addr_ok!"
